- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "The Detective's Assistant" by Kate Hannigan is an exciting historical fiction novel about a young girl named Nell who becomes the assistant to her aunt, a detective, in the late 1800s.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Nell's life changes drastically when her mother dies and she is sent to live with her aunt, Kate Warne, who is a Pinkerton detective.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Kate sees potential in Nell and trains her to become her assistant, teaching her skills such as code-breaking, disguises, and deductive reasoning.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Together, Kate and Nell embark on dangerous missions to solve crimes and capture criminals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] They work undercover to uncover secrets and gather evidence, using their wits and resourcefulness to outsmart even the cleverest of villains.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] As they work on their cases, Nell learns more about her family history and discovers secrets about her mother's past.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] "The Detective's Assistant" is a thrilling adventure story that teaches young readers about bravery, perseverance, and the importance of following your dreams.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] It is also a celebration of the power of female friendship and the impact that strong, determined women can have on the world.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Eddie is a passionate basketball player and fan, and he dreams of playing in the NBA someday.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When his school enters a contest to win a halftime show during an NBA game, Eddie is chosen to represent his school and take a shot from half-court to win a million dollars.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Eddie is excited and nervous about the opportunity, but he is determined to make the shot.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] With the help of his best friend, Annie, he practices every day, perfecting his technique and increasing his chances of success.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] As the big game approaches, Eddie and Annie face challenges and setbacks, but they never give up hope.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] When Eddie finally takes the shot during halftime, the crowd goes wild as the ball sails through the air and lands in the basket.
